traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Plant pathogen causing a disease in Vaccinium species. The fungus induces the host to produce large, swollen, often brightly colored galls in which the fungus proliferates and produces spores. Although it can reduce the aesthetic value of ornamental plants, it is generally not harmful to the overall health of the host plant.
